review: I have never written one of these before. I do not know if anyone reads them. But this album has my mother in it and I need to say so somewhere. She died the week my second was born and I have not had one hour to sit down about it in eight years. "El Rosario de Abuela" — one bead, one name. That was her, every night, at the kitchen table, and she said my name in it and I never once thanked her for that. I played this in the car in the school pickup line and I had to put my sunglasses on before the kids got in. Gracias por esto. De verdad.
